visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male host with short dark hair, wearing a white button-down shirt, is seated in a modern studio environment with a metallic grid background. He holds an opened Zongzi in his hands, looking at it with a high-energy, surprised facial expression while pointing his index finger upwards. (2) The shot transitions to an extreme close-up of the food held by a pair of chopsticks. A large piece of abalone is displayed, glistening under bright studio lights. The background shows a white plate and the rest of the dumpling, emphasizing the variety of premium ingredients. (3) The host is shown eating the dumpling, with close-up inserts of the spoon lifting sticky rice and chestnuts. He nods approvingly, his eyes widening to show satisfaction. A large teal gift box with floral patterns from Fujin Tree is positioned prominently on the table. (4) The final phase shows promotional graphics for Fujin Tree products. The host continues to speak directly to the camera, gesturing with his hands. Images of other dishes like braised pork and fish soup are overlaid on the screen with quantity indicators.
